name: nowssb-app
description: NowssB — Shabdapathy. The web app, and the Capacitor shell that puts the same code in the Play Store and the App Store.

scripts.android:add: npm run build:native && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:native && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run build:native && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:add: npm run build:native && npx cap add ios && npm run ios:assets && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:native && npm run ios:assets && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run build:native && npx cap run ios
scripts.sync: npm run build:native && npx cap sync
